parts:
Hi all,

Regular work sessions return next week, at the normal time: 3:10-5:00 in Wickson 2124. This Monday, Rosemary Hartman will give a talk about parallel processing. From Rosie:

>I will present some background on the theory behind parallel processing, then demonstrate a specific example using the doParallel and foreach packages with stochastic simulation modeling. This should be helpful for anyone wanting to speed up their code!

In the second half of the meeting, we'll have our regular co-work/Q&A time. Bring your work and questions, I'll bring cookies.

Noam
